title: Victoria ResCode, Clause 54 (one dwelling on a lot)
publisher: Victorian Government, Department of Transport and Planning
disclaimer: PLANNING, NOT BUILDING CODE. Clause 54 sits in every Victorian planning scheme and governs a single dwelling on a lot; Clause 55 governs two or more. Amendment VC282 reshaped Clause 54 from 8 September 2025 -- street setbacks were reduced and the assessment of dwellings on small lots changed -- so CONFIRM WHICH VERSION APPLIES to the application date. Under the amended scheme a local variation applies only where it is MORE permissive than the state standard. Overlooking, overshadowing, daylight to existing windows, walls on boundaries and neighbourhood character are not encoded.

site.$comment: State standards under the amended Clause 54. A local schedule may be more permissive.

rules.title: Site coverage
rules.message: Site coverage is {coverage_ratio}; Clause 54 caps it at 60%.
rules.note: Some zones and schedules set a lower figure.

rules.title: Street setback
rules.message: The street setback is {setback_front_mm} mm. Post-VC282 the state standard is commonly 6 m, reducing to 4 m in some cases.
rules.note: The standard is partly set by the setbacks of adjoining dwellings, which is not modelled.

design.$comment: Regional construction practice, not a code requirement. Override per project.
